name: CeraVe Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum 30ml | Hydrating, Barrier-Repair & Anti-Aging
description:
CeraVe Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a lightweight, fragrance-free formula designed to deeply hydrate and plump dry, sensitive skin. Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, and Ceramides, it restores the skin barrier, locks in moisture, and improves overall skin texture. Suitable for daily use, this serum supports healthy, soft, and supple skin while helping reduce signs of aging.
Key Features
 Deeply hydrates and plumps dry skin
 Restores and strengthens the skin barrier
 Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, and Ceramides
 Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and fragrance-free
 Suitable for sensitive and all skin types
 Supports anti-aging and improves overall skin texture
How to Use
 Apply a few drops to clean, dry face
 Gently massage until fully absorbed
 Use morning and night for best results
 Follow with moisturizer
Material
Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin B5, Ceramides, serum base
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30ml CeraVe Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum
